signature_building_plans.notes: 24 temporary refuge places with supplies and local guidance. This is a finite overnight refuge, not a permanent population allocation.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Counterweight Hall
signature_building_plans.notes: Potable storage is separate from wastewater. Diagram defines scene layout, not real-world plumbing or engineering certification.
signature_building_plans.special: Machinery hall with vertical counterweight wells below the footprint; below-deck depth 24 m, enclosed against public entry.

signature_building_plans.name: Sailmakers Court
signature_building_plans.notes: Ventilation and noise remain in the work district; hot work uses the regional kiln annex rather than an invented exhaust under a home.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Windward Rescue Dock
signature_building_plans.notes: 24 temporary refuge places with supplies and local guidance. This is a finite overnight refuge, not a permanent population allocation.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Winter Hall
signature_building_plans.motif: steam porch and ice light baffle
signature_building_plans.notes: Open stall bays connect directly to the aisle. Storage is within each stall allocation. Both ends remain open to public exit courts.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Echo Archive
signature_building_plans.motif: steam porch and ice light baffle
signature_building_plans.notes: Upper floor repeats controlled archive rooms. Public records and private records have distinct permissions.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Warm Ridge Observatory
signature_building_plans.motif: steam porch and ice light baffle
signature_building_plans.notes: Upper floor repeats controlled archive rooms. Public records and private records have distinct permissions.
signature_building_plans.special: Upper observing deck within the same footprint, roof instrument centered over the reading/measurement hall; no arbitrary extra tower footprint.

signature_building_plans.name: Common Kiln Hall
signature_building_plans.motif: gas vent marker and cooled bridge
signature_building_plans.notes: Ventilation and noise remain in the work district; hot work uses the regional kiln annex rather than an invented exhaust under a home.
signature_building_plans.special: Hot work is in a separately marked 12 x 10 m annex centered 35 m north of this hall, with a clear open-air separation. Add it as B01-A1 in the instance registry.

signature_building_plans.name: Spring Garden House
signature_building_plans.motif: gas vent marker and cooled bridge
signature_building_plans.notes: Two learning groups of 16 per session. Furniture and signs adapt to differing body size and reach.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Fungal Exchange
signature_building_plans.notes: Open stall bays connect directly to the aisle. Storage is within each stall allocation. Both ends remain open to public exit courts.
signature_building_plans.special: Use the room allocations shown; movable furnishings may vary without shifting walls, doors or stairs.

signature_building_plans.name: Pressure Gate House
signature_building_plans.notes: 24 temporary refuge places with supplies and local guidance. This is a finite overnight refuge, not a permanent population allocation.
signature_building_plans.special: West 8 x 10 m allocation contains two 4 x 4 m vestibules at (0,0) and (4,0), a 2 m control passage y=4..6, and a 4 m deep equipment zone y=6..10. No instant descent.

encounter_plans.name: Floodglass Ford
encounter_plans.notes: Two visible shore approaches; high refuge on north bank; no hidden tunnel.
encounter_plans.hazard: Flood-wyrm spawning and sudden flow changes.

encounter_plans.name: Walking Root Crossing
encounter_plans.notes: Ridge west, crown east; two fall-arrest anchor stations and a lower rescue shelf.
encounter_plans.hazard: Crown migration stretches lashings; mawroot plants imitate sheltered warmth off the marked path.

encounter_plans.name: The Buried Lens
encounter_plans.notes: One excavated stair and a separate maintenance ramp; shafts are light wells, not walkable escape holes.
encounter_plans.hazard: Glass storm, reflected false bearings, glassback drake nests.

encounter_plans.name: Drowned Archive
encounter_plans.notes: Upper landing and two raised exits remain above the expected low-tide window; boats are staged outside.
encounter_plans.hazard: Rising water, unstable floors and a passing reefback.

encounter_plans.name: Blackwake Mooring
encounter_plans.notes: Three docking arms, two refuge cells, exposed winch deck; no infinite aircraft hangar.
encounter_plans.hazard: Wind shear, overloaded spans and hostage coercion.

encounter_plans.name: The Cut Span
encounter_plans.notes: North and south abutments are separate; a safe foot detour takes two days and does not reconnect the span.
encounter_plans.hazard: Real coupled resonance hazard and choirwraith territory beyond the marked ridge.

encounter_plans.name: Ashmouth Freight Yard
encounter_plans.notes: One wagon approach, one narrow foot path, fenced gas trough; both routes are mapped.
encounter_plans.hazard: Ashmaws follow heat plumes; gang patrols guard movable stolen freight.

encounter_plans.name: Bellwater Narrows
encounter_plans.notes: Sea approaches east and west, foot access south to the refuge, no route to the Burrow.
encounter_plans.hazard: Bell-eels hunt vibration; pressure change can close the water route.

surface_locations.name: Sunwell Market
surface_locations.role: The civic center: daily exchange, news and informal decisions.
anchors: Round limestone well curb at the world origin; sealed potable-water draw point, never an energy core.
Four dark inset paving rays mark north, east, south and west.
Green canvas stalls occupy the north and west edges; the east route stays clear.
A freestanding timber noticeboard stands at (18,20,0).
doors: Open east to Gate Lane, south to Hearth Lane, west to Workshop Lane and north to Garden Way.
surface_locations.daily_life: Produce arrives before breakfast. Neighbors trade repairs, food and information. A returned tool matters as much as a sale.
surface_locations.story_use: Let the community solve ordinary problems here. A future false notice has recognizable recipients and consequences.
surface_locations.game_use: Home hub, dialogue, noticeboard quests and map orientation. No random hazards in the peaceful baseline.
continuity_limits: Keep the center open. Stalls move only within marked bays. Never mirror the paving compass or move the well.

surface_locations.name: Common House & Tables
surface_locations.role: A communal kitchen, shared meal room and meeting place open to the market.
anchors: Long north-facing porch; three permanent stone table bases in its forecourt.
Warm plaster, green shutters, copper kitchen vent on the southwest corner.
Four friends usually sit at the eastern porch table; it is not privately reserved.
doors: Main double doors centered in the north wall.
Kitchen service door in west wall.
Second exit in southeast corner.
surface_locations.daily_life: Households have their own kitchens. This kitchen serves workers, visitors and shared meals; no one must earn food through heroics.
surface_locations.story_use: The emotional home of the pilot and a repeatable place for disagreements, apologies and celebrations.
surface_locations.game_use: Rest, party conversations and meal preparation. Healing/rest is a game interaction, not instant story-world magic.
continuity_limits: Do not turn the forecourt into a different plaza. Seasonal cloths and food are state changes.

surface_locations.name: Hearth Terraces
surface_locations.role: The principal residential neighborhood, built into the southern rock.
anchors: Three inhabited tiers at +6, +12 and +18 metres.
Pale stone lower walls, dark timber balconies, slate roofs and individual colored doors.
Madger and Snow share the ground-level accessible home entry at the west end of the +12 m terrace.
doors: Each dwelling opens to a public gallery.
Stairs shorten the route; the western switchback ramp reaches every occupied tier.
surface_locations.daily_life: Laundry, school bags, meals, repairs and quiet hours make this a neighborhood rather than a backdrop.
surface_locations.story_use: Private thresholds give friendships boundaries. Residents have plans independent of the heroes.
surface_locations.game_use: Home save point and optional conversations. Occupied homes are not loot containers.
continuity_limits: This edition fixes neighborhood massing and Madger/Snow entry, not every unseen room or every resident name.

surface_locations.name: Garden Terraces
surface_locations.role: North terraces for produce, plant starts and shared learning.
anchors: Three broad planted bands at +6, +12 and +18 metres.
Two low greenhouses sit at the eastern end of the +12 m terrace.
Garden crossing BRW-C02 links the lower path to Garden Way.
doors: South stair from Garden Way.
Long west ramp for carts and mobility access.
surface_locations.daily_life: Growers share water schedules. Greens, roots and fruit supplement traded grain; gardens do not magically feed everyone alone.
surface_locations.story_use: A future changed delivery schedule can cause a missed watering without threatening the whole town at once.
surface_locations.game_use: Cultivation, observation and soil-route tutorials in designated beds only.
continuity_limits: No new cliff or waterfall between tiers. North remains north in every season.

surface_locations.name: Spring House
surface_locations.role: Protected source, settling tanks and the start of separate water systems.
anchors: Low limestone vault built into the northwest wall.
Three labeled valve wheels inside; a fenced settling court outside.
Drinking-water tanks are covered; the utility race is visibly separate.
doors: South inspection entrance from Garden Ramp.
surface_locations.daily_life: A water team checks clarity and flow physically and records the result before opening the daily allocation.
surface_locations.story_use: Careful work becomes familiar before any later attempt to falsify it.
surface_locations.game_use: Inspection puzzles and valve routing with a local effect; never a universal town-off switch.
continuity_limits: No bathing or dumping in potable tanks. Water flows downhill along fixed routes.

surface_locations.name: Waterhouse
surface_locations.role: Water-driven power and maintenance beside the western wheelrace.
anchors: One 6 m diameter vertical waterwheel on the east wall.
Separate mechanical sluice and electrical isolator.
Wheelrace runs on the building's east side; the workshop stands south.
doors: South door to the workshop court.
West equipment door to perimeter service path.
surface_locations.daily_life: Operators clean grates and compare local gauges; nearby roofs add solar power and local batteries.
surface_locations.story_use: Local consequences create practical rescue and repair stories later.
surface_locations.game_use: Environmental repair and supervised mechanisms. No unrestricted control of the entire settlement.
continuity_limits: The wheel never migrates to the gate or north gardens. Power and drinking water remain independent.

surface_locations.name: Gorilla White's Workshop
surface_locations.role: A public repair workshop where Gorilla White works alongside other craftspeople.
anchors: Wide east-facing pair of timber doors.
Big shared bench beneath north windows; blue tool silhouettes on the west rack.
A small private rest alcove is behind the south partition, never in the public tool aisle.
doors: East workshop doors to the court.
North service door to Waterhouse.
South door to the western walk.
surface_locations.daily_life: Repair tickets are public. Apprentices do real work. Gorilla accepts help and takes turns being off duty.
surface_locations.story_use: Repairs reveal community relationships; strength can support rather than replace other people.
surface_locations.game_use: Upgrade station, craft tasks and companion conversation. Purchases do not rewrite plot outcomes.
continuity_limits: No weapon factory in the peaceful baseline. Shelves may gain tools; walls and doors stay fixed.

surface_locations.name: Training Court
surface_locations.role: A safe, open practice yard with marked soil lanes and rescue exercises.
anchors: Low timber boundary on three sides; east entrance stays open.
Two sand/soil strips, reusable wooden obstacles and a rope-rescue frame.
Soft soil lane A runs north-south inside the court; buried utilities are outside its bounds.
doors: East public entrance from the lower ring walk.
North equipment gate toward workshop.
surface_locations.daily_life: Children practice coordination; adults rehearse carrying and rescue. Training is scheduled around rest hours.
surface_locations.story_use: A place for effort, humor, failure and gradual competence before a real emergency.
surface_locations.game_use: Jump, guard and BURROW tutorials. Down/S/down-swipe/BURROW retain their established behavior.
continuity_limits: Digging is allowed only in defined soil volumes; never phase through stone, homes or pipes.

surface_locations.name: Records House
surface_locations.role: Bot's workroom, local records and the room where evidence is compared.
anchors: Slate-blue shutters and copper cable trays.
A public counter at the south; comparison table in the center.
Offline records cabinet at the north; Bot's charging dock at the northeast.
doors: South public entrance.
East maintenance door.
surface_locations.daily_life: People can correct records and ask how a decision was made. Bot helps; he does not own everyone's information.
surface_locations.story_use: An uncertain observation can be preserved without becoming an accusation.
surface_locations.game_use: Quest journal, evidence board and local electronics tasks. Story knowledge and player discoveries are separate states.
continuity_limits: No all-seeing surveillance wall or omniscient AI. The pilot does not name an attacker.

surface_locations.name: Storehouse & Trading Court
surface_locations.role: Dry staples, tools and an interior receiving yard.
anchors: Long green double doors on the east.
Raised dry floor, numbered shelves, reusable D-series delivery tags.
Receiving court on the east is broad enough to turn a handcart.
doors: East cart entrance.
North staff door toward Gate Lane.
West inventory exit.
surface_locations.daily_life: Outside trade supplies grain, cloth and spare parts. The shared reserve buffers interruptions; households keep personal supplies.
surface_locations.story_use: A missing crate means a specific repair or meal is delayed. Outsiders are not automatically suspicious.
surface_locations.game_use: Supplies, delivery errands and restoration materials. No invented real-money reward economy.
continuity_limits: D17 is a delivery identifier, not a prophecy, secret emblem or villain's name.

surface_locations.name: Care House
surface_locations.role: A quiet neighborhood clinic and recovery space.
anchors: Cream shutters, a simple blue circle sign and a planted waiting porch.
Two rest rooms behind the reception area.
doors: North accessible entrance.
West service exit.
surface_locations.daily_life: Ordinary checkups, rest and help for injuries; care does not depend on game rank.
surface_locations.story_use: Consequences and recovery have a place, without turning every danger into spectacle.
surface_locations.game_use: Recovery and rescue handoff. Actual story injuries follow the event ledger.
continuity_limits: Do not replace it with a prison, armory or secret lab without an explicit canon revision.

surface_locations.name: East Bridge
surface_locations.role: The main public crossing between Gate Lane and the interior arrival court.
anchors: 12 m east-west deck over a 6 m north-south canal; low stone abutments.
Pale repaired timber, waist-high simple rails, three modest green pennants for the reopening.
No overhead structure and no chasm.
doors: West landing at x=164.
East landing at x=176.
surface_locations.daily_life: Carts and pedestrians take turns on the crossing. Service Crossing provides a bypass during maintenance.
surface_locations.story_use: A shared accomplishment in Episode 1, repaired after ordinary seasonal weather.
surface_locations.game_use: Landmark, route choice and later defense position. Fixed geometry in every mode.
continuity_limits: No collapse, sabotage reveal or large arched stone replacement in the pilot.

surface_locations.name: Inner Arrival Court
surface_locations.role: An internal handoff space between East Bridge and the public gate vestibule.
anchors: Open paved court, shaded waiting bench on the north and two marked cart bays.
Delivery bell and small green status display beside the gate approach.
Visitors and deliveries are welcome in ordinary life. Pilot shots stay on interior ground and look inward.
doors: West toward bridge.
East into the internal gate vestibule.
South into Service Walk.
surface_locations.daily_life: A gate steward receives visitors and compares paper tags with the local record.
surface_locations.story_use: Show hospitality and careful procedure together. One duplicate receipt quietly contradicts a simple count.
surface_locations.game_use: Arrival/tutorial staging and visitor interactions without exposing undefined exterior terrain.
continuity_limits: No view past the exterior threshold in Episode 1.

surface_locations.name: East Gate
surface_locations.role: A recessed gate vestibule and the main public threshold at the east rock wall.
anchors: Twin timber-and-iron gate leaves at x=294.
Mechanical crossbar on the inside, independent of the arrival log; disengaged when the public gate is open.
Inner relay cabinet BRW-15 is on the south wall: the right wall when facing outward/east.
Vestibule mouth at x=270 opens into the arrival court.
doors: Exterior leaf plane stays at x=294. Public passage is open during ordinary daytime. The pilot uses inward framing; no unassigned exterior landscape is shown.
Vestibule west mouth remains x=270. Leaves may close routinely at night or under an explicit protective state.
surface_locations.daily_life: Staff open and close it; electronics record observations and schedules, not physical permission by themselves.
surface_locations.story_use: The same visible bar, leaves and cabinet make the last unexplained receipt legible.
surface_locations.game_use: Future adventure boundary; locked by the current quest state, not by an invented wall across the market.
continuity_limits: Do not confuse the outdoor public gate with the new underground inner gates. Normal hospitality and defensive readiness coexist.

surface_locations.name: Service Walk & Gate Relay
surface_locations.role: Public maintenance access along the inner south side of the gate.
anchors: Slate paving, one shallow drain and one inspection hatch at (264,-26,0).
Cabinet R-E01 mounted at (282,-8.5,1.2), on the vestibule's south wall.
Cabinet door is flush and intact in the pilot; its display uses ordinary muted green.
doors: North access from arrival court; return through the west vestibule mouth to reach the cabinet on its inner south wall.
No shortcut through the solid south vestibule wall.
surface_locations.daily_life: Maintenance is scheduled and logged. The place is mundane before Snow notices an unfamiliar trace.
surface_locations.story_use: A held indication and recorded time create a question; the source remains unknown.
surface_locations.game_use: Inspection, local relay isolation and evidence comparisons in later missions.
continuity_limits: Never move the cabinet to the north wall. Never imply Snow can smell a digital hack.

surface_locations.name: Makers' Room & Archive
surface_locations.role: A shared studio, reading room and record of community projects.
anchors: Ochre door facing south, long north worktable and east archive wall.
Displayed objects have credited makers and recorded histories.
doors: South public entrance.
West service exit.
surface_locations.daily_life: Neighbors draw, record stories, learn skills and mend small objects. Celebrations add dated artifacts.
surface_locations.story_use: A living memory of past adventures without inventing ancient prophecy.
surface_locations.game_use: Creator Studio and Trophy Chamber functions share this building; neither becomes an extra wing by accident.
continuity_limits: No unrecorded trophy from an adventure the characters have not had.

surface_locations.name: Hearth Public Entry
surface_locations.role: A welcoming gallery below the Hearth Terraces. Public doors at (-30,-100,0) lead to lifts/stairs landing in the Welcome Hall. A continuous ramp provides a powered-lift-independent route.
continuity_limits: Public in ordinary life. Entry is a civic threshold, not a private club or a token-holder gate.

surface_locations.name: Welcome Hall
surface_locations.role: The underground arrival hall: visitor information, seating, stroller/cart space and a steward desk. All main-entry routes arrive here before the inner boundary.
continuity_limits: Queue space remains before the two inner closures. No lift or ramp may discharge directly behind the inner gates.

surface_locations.name: Inner Gate Gallery
surface_locations.role: A broad civic passage with two independently operated inner closures. Both are open on ordinary days.
continuity_limits: Closure lines at y=-144 and y=-128 protect the town beyond. Staff confirm people are clear; no automatic trapping of a crowded passage.

surface_locations.name: Underhall Commons
surface_locations.role: A busy indoor high street with everyday shops, shared tables, a meeting square and neighborhood directions.
continuity_limits: The central circulation cross stays open. This is a daily public place, not an empty bunker.

surface_locations.name: West Lantern Warren
surface_locations.role: Four household courts, shared play rooms, deliveries, doorways, kitchens and quiet residential galleries. Planning occupancy: 400 residents / 100 homes.
continuity_limits: Lantern is a neighborhood name and ordinary lighting; no magical energy object. Private room layouts stay unassigned until drawn.

surface_locations.name: East Orchard Warren
surface_locations.role: Four dense residential courts with family homes, planted gathering pockets and neighbor-run shops. Planning occupancy: 400 residents / 100 homes.
continuity_limits: Plants are decorative and locally grown; they do not imply unlimited daylight or a self-feeding town.

surface_locations.name: School & Play Hall
surface_locations.role: Classrooms, reading, supervised play, making and community learning used by children from both surface and underground homes.
continuity_limits: Children retain ordinary routines and protected gathering areas; danger does not turn the school into a combat room.

surface_locations.name: Care & Community Hall
surface_locations.role: Clinic rooms, recovery, community meals and a separate kitchen wing, with independent clean and service circulation.
continuity_limits: Clinical rooms remain private. Kitchen noise and deliveries stay outside the care-room aisle.

surface_locations.name: Central Lift & Stair Court
surface_locations.role: A stacked neighborhood interchange at -12, -24 and -36 m, with ordinary lifts and independent stairs.
continuity_limits: This core has no direct surface entrance. It connects only the protected side of the underground town.

surface_locations.name: Service Receiving Hall
surface_locations.role: Freight from the workshop service passage is checked, staged and handed into the west neighborhood through a local closure.
continuity_limits: The dock gate is a separate surface-to-town defensive boundary; it cannot be left as an unguarded bypass.

surface_locations.name: West Deep Warren
surface_locations.role: A second residential neighborhood, equal in dignity and quality to the upper warren. Planning occupancy: 400 residents / 100 homes.
continuity_limits: Depth is not a class hierarchy. These residents use surface gardens, markets and celebrations daily.

surface_locations.name: East Deep Warren
surface_locations.role: Dense family courtyards, homes, doorstep shops and social galleries on the second inhabited level. Planning occupancy: 400 residents / 100 homes.
continuity_limits: The four wards are normal permanent homes, not temporary emergency beds.

surface_locations.name: Deep Commons & Kitchens
surface_locations.role: A shared meal hall, neighborhood shops and kitchens beside the lower residential streets.
continuity_limits: Keep food preparation, clean stores and waste handling distinct. Household kitchens also exist.

surface_locations.name: Food Gardens & Grow Rooms
surface_locations.role: Powered growing rooms, seed storage and food preparation for selected greens, herbs and plant starts.
continuity_limits: Grow lights require power. Underground cultivation supplements surface gardens and external trade; it does not feed everybody alone.

surface_locations.name: Assembly & Refuge Hall
surface_locations.role: Used daily for gatherings, sport, performances and clubs. In a protective state it receives surface residents, with rest, care and family reunification zones.
continuity_limits: 800 additional refuge places is a production planning target, not a certified capacity. Do not displace underground households to make refuge space.

surface_locations.name: Baths & Laundry
surface_locations.role: Shared baths, private washing rooms, laundry, drying and neighborhood maintenance stores.
continuity_limits: Separate clean water from drainage. No connection opens through the Welcome Hall above.

surface_locations.name: Utility Repair Hall
surface_locations.role: Maintainable local power distribution, battery rooms, spare equipment and repair benches.
continuity_limits: Separate zones can be isolated. A failure here cannot be written as an unexplained instant shutdown of all life support.

surface_locations.name: Water & Air Service Rooms
surface_locations.role: Partitioned potable reserve, wastewater lift plant, drainage sumps and air-handling rooms.
continuity_limits: Wastewater must be pumped up to the existing -3 m service level; it cannot flow uphill by gravity. Independent duty/backup equipment and local controls.

surface_locations.name: Deep Stores
surface_locations.role: Dry staples, household supplies, repair materials and documented community reserves.
continuity_limits: Stock quantities change in the event ledger. No infinite supplies or unearned emergency solution.

surface_locations.name: West Stair & Refuge Core
surface_locations.role: An independent protected stair/refuge core links all three underground levels to the surface service walk at (-210,-40,0).
continuity_limits: Outside entry is locally controlled. Occupants can leave from inside without network permission; surface conditions still determine whether evacuation is safe.

surface_locations.name: East Stair & Refuge Core
surface_locations.role: A second separated protected stair/refuge core links all levels to the surface service walk at (144,-40,0).
continuity_limits: This is a distinct route from the west core. Include it in any surface-overrun state and keep staff able to operate it locally.

underground_areas.name: Water & Air Service Rooms
underground_areas.role: Partitioned potable reserve, wastewater lift plant, drainage sumps and air-handling rooms.
continuity_limits: Wastewater must be pumped up to the existing -3 m service level; it cannot flow uphill by gravity. Independent duty/backup equipment and local controls.

underground_areas.name: Deep Stores
underground_areas.role: Dry staples, household supplies, repair materials and documented community reserves.
continuity_limits: Stock quantities change in the event ledger. No infinite supplies or unearned emergency solution.

underground_areas.name: West Stair & Refuge Core
underground_areas.role: An independent protected stair/refuge core links all three underground levels to the surface service walk at (-210,-40,0).
continuity_limits: Outside entry is locally controlled. Occupants can leave from inside without network permission; surface conditions still determine whether evacuation is safe.

underground_areas.name: East Stair & Refuge Core
underground_areas.role: A second separated protected stair/refuge core links all levels to the surface service walk at (144,-40,0).
continuity_limits: This is a distinct route from the west core. Include it in any surface-overrun state and keep staff able to operate it locally.

sub_locations.name: Mara's Bread Counter
sub_locations.purpose: A small shop with counted bread stock, a pickup counter and room to queue off the public crossing.
sub_locations.route: Prepared bread arrives from UG-12 through UG-08 to UG-03; this counter has no industrial oven or new exhaust shaft.
sub_locations.public: Front of house and pickup counter. Stock and handwash nook are staff space.
sub_locations.story: A promised order competes with Mara's capacity. A correction is visible on the order slate.
permanent: South entrance centered on the bay
Counter behind a clear customer zone
state: Daily bread, order slate, staff shift, returned baskets

sub_locations.name: Repair & Tool Loan
sub_locations.purpose: A neighborhood handoff point for small repairs and loan tools. Large or hazardous work goes to BRW-07.
sub_locations.route: Goods arrive through ordinary commons routes. No direct workshop tunnel is added.
sub_locations.public: Ticket counter, safe display and pickup. Bench and tool storage are supervised.
sub_locations.story: Tavi must admit a repair is not ready. An honestly delayed handoff preserves trust.
state: Repair tickets, loan tags, active project, staff shift

sub_locations.name: Pantry & Produce
sub_locations.purpose: A measured neighborhood supply shop for fresh produce, dry staples and household containers.
sub_locations.route: Supplies come from BRW-10, UG-18, surface gardens and UG-13 using recorded routes and receiving handoffs.
sub_locations.public: Display and counter. The covered stock zone is staff space.
sub_locations.story: A delivery mismatch delays one meal or job; it does not instantly starve the town.
state: Stock quantities, labels, delivery tags, substitute goods

sub_locations.name: Jun's Mending Room
sub_locations.purpose: Mending, fitting and small sign work, with a clear private fitting area and visible pickup rack.
sub_locations.route: Ordinary street access only. Materials move by cart; no new wall opening connects adjacent shops.
sub_locations.public: Consultation table and pickup. Fitting privacy is controlled by the person using it.
sub_locations.story: A visible repair becomes something a resident values instead of something Jun has to hide.
state: Cloth rolls, appointment cards, repairs and posted signs

sub_locations.name: Learning Room One
sub_locations.purpose: One of the four already allocated learning rooms, for a flexible group of about 16 learners. Other rooms and shifts share the school demand.
sub_locations.route: South door enters the school's central circulation strip, then the existing west connection to UG-08.
sub_locations.public: Classroom access follows the teaching schedule; guardians and visitors check in with staff.
sub_locations.story: A group redesigns a confusing wayfinding card. Each learner contributes a different observation.
permanent: South entry and clear central aisle
West materials and east reading corner
state: Desk groupings, lesson materials, projects, attendance

sub_locations.name: Care Room One
sub_locations.purpose: A private assessment and recovery room within the already allocated clinic zone, with a quiet waiting position and handwash point.
sub_locations.route: South door meets the care hall's central circulation, separate from the kitchen and food handling.
sub_locations.public: Entry by invitation or a care handoff. Personal records are not visible from the corridor.
sub_locations.story: An exhausted helper accepts rest and asks someone else to finish a job.
state: Occupancy, screen position, supplies and care handoff

sub_locations.name: Lantern Street Home 001
sub_locations.purpose: A compact 48 m2 household home within the southwest frontage of the northwest court. It is one of the ward's 100 planned homes, not an extra unit.
sub_locations.route: South door opens onto the ward's existing central street. No private route reaches the surface or another level.
sub_locations.public: The doorstep faces a public gallery; the interior requires the household's permission. Occupants are intentionally not assigned yet.
sub_locations.story: A private household moment shows why a shared town matters. The heroes are guests, not owners of every room.
permanent: West wash compartment and service wall
state: Household assignment, furniture, decoration and ordinary wear
